historiographic_tone_recommendations.modernization_narrative_treatment: VALIDATE and CONTEXTUALIZE — Literacy improvements from Ottoman alphabet reform (2.5% → 30%+) were genuine societal benefits AND alphabet change severed access to pre-1928 knowledge systems. Both true simultaneously. Not either/or; both/and.
historiographic_tone_recommendations.suppression_narrative_treatment: EVIDENCE-BASED — Soviet Russification policies documented; China 2025 education policy verified from Western sources (geopolitical perspective gap noted). Distinguish coercion (state mandate) from incentive (economic opportunity). Coercion established for Soviet case; China case combines both.
historiographic_tone_recommendations.diaspora_narrative_treatment: QUALIFIED and RESEARCH-FORWARD — Tatar communities in Turkey maintain institutions (fact); younger diaspora also experience language shift (counter-fact); quantitative comparison missing (research gap). Don't overstate diaspora success; acknowledge complexity.
historiographic_tone_recommendations.psychological_impact_treatment: PLAUSIBLE HYPOTHESIS — Research links language loss to psychological distress; causation direction unclear; reverse causality possible (marginalization causes both). Label as research frontier, not established fact.
historiographic_tone_recommendations.islamic_preservation_treatment: ACKNOWLEDGED ABSENCE — Islamic texts likely important to Turkic cultural identity historically; specific preservation mechanism under linguistic suppression not yet researched. Honest about not knowing; avoid speculation.
